verses.original: Παῦλος κλητὸς ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ καὶ Σωσθένης ὁ ἀδελφὸς
verses.transliteration: Paulos klētos apostolos Christou Iēsou dia thelēmatos Theou kai Sōsthenēs ho adelphos
verses.literal: Paul called to be an apostle of Christ Jesus by the will of God and our brother Sosthenes

verses.original: Τῇ ἐκκλησίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ τῇ οὔσῃ ἐν Κορίνθῳ ἡγιασμένοις ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ κλητοῖς ἁγίοις σὺν πᾶσιν τοῖς ἐπικαλουμένοις τὸ ὄνομα τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ αὐτῶν καὶ ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: Tē ekklēsia tou Theou tē ousē en Korinthō hēgiasmenois en Christō Iēsou klētois hagiois syn pasin tois epikaloumenois to onoma tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou en panti topō autōn kai hēmōn
verses.literal: To the church of God - in Corinth to those sanctified in Christ Jesus and called to be holy together with all those everywhere who call on the name of our Lord Jesus Christ their Lord and ours

verses.original: Χάρις ὑμῖν καὶ εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς ἡμῶν καὶ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: Charis hymin kai eirēnē apo Theou Patros hēmōn kai Kyriou Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: Εὐχαριστῶ τῷ Θεῷ μου πάντοτε περὶ ὑμῶν ἐπὶ τῇ χάριτι τοῦ Θεοῦ τῇ δοθείσῃ ὑμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ
verses.transliteration: Eucharistō tō Theō mou pantote peri hymōn epi tē chariti tou Theou tē dotheisē hymin en Christō Iēsou
verses.literal: I always thank . . . my God for you because of the grace He has given you in Christ Jesus

verses.original: ὅτι ἐν παντὶ ἐπλουτίσθητε ἐν αὐτῷ ἐν παντὶ λόγῳ καὶ πάσῃ γνώσει
verses.transliteration: hoti en panti eploutisthēte en autō en panti logō kai pasē gnōsei
verses.literal: For in Him you have been enriched in every way in all speech and all knowledge

verses.original: καθὼς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Χριστοῦ ἐβεβαιώθη ἐν ὑμῖν
verses.transliteration: kathōs to martyrion tou Christou ebebaiōthē en hymin
verses.literal: because our testimony about Christ was confirmed in you

verses.original: ὥστε ὑμᾶς μὴ ὑστερεῖσθαι ἐν μηδενὶ χαρίσματι ἀπεκδεχομένους τὴν ἀποκάλυψιν τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hōste hymas mē hystereisthai en mēdeni charismati apekdechomenous tēn apokalypsin tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: Therefore you do not lack . . . any spiritual gift as you eagerly await the revelation of our Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὃς καὶ βεβαιώσει ὑμᾶς ἕως τέλους ἀνεγκλήτους ἐν τῇ ἡμέρᾳ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: hos kai bebaiōsei hymas heōs telous anenklētous en tē hēmera tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: He will sustain you to the end so that you will be blameless on the day of our Lord Jesus Christ

verses.original: πιστὸς ὁ Θεὸς δι’ οὗ ἐκλήθητε εἰς κοινωνίαν τοῦ Υἱοῦ αὐτοῦ Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν
verses.transliteration: pistos ho Theos di’ hou eklēthēte eis koinōnian tou Huiou autou Iēsou Christou tou Kyriou hēmōn
verses.literal: God who has called you into fellowship with His Son Jesus Christ our Lord is faithful

verses.original: Παρακαλῶ δὲ ὑμᾶς ἀδελφοί διὰ τοῦ ὀνόματος τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ ἵνα τὸ αὐτὸ λέγητε πάντες καὶ μὴ ᾖ ἐν ὑμῖν σχίσματα ἦτε δὲ κατηρτισμένοι ἐν τῷ αὐτῷ νοῒ καὶ ἐν τῇ αὐτῇ γνώμῃ
verses.transliteration: Parakalō de hymas adelphoi dia tou onomatos tou Kyriou hēmōn Iēsou Christou hina to auto legēte pantes kai mē ē en hymin schismata ēte de katērtismenoi en tō autō noi kai en tē autē gnōmē
verses.literal: I appeal to you brothers in the name of our Lord Jesus Christ that all of you agree together . . . . . . so that there may be no divisions among you and that you may be united in - mind and - conviction

verses.original: ἐδηλώθη γάρ μοι περὶ ὑμῶν ἀδελφοί μου ὑπὸ τῶν Χλόης ὅτι ἔριδες ἐν ὑμῖν εἰσιν
verses.transliteration: edēlōthē gar moi peri hymōn adelphoi mou hypo tōn Chloēs hoti erides en hymin eisin
verses.literal: My brothers some from Chloe’s household have informed me - that there are quarrels among you

verses.original: λέγω δὲ τοῦτο ὅτι ἕκαστος ὑμῶν λέγει Ἐγὼ μέν εἰμι Παύλου Ἐγὼ δὲ Ἀπολλῶ Ἐγὼ δὲ Κηφᾶ Ἐγὼ δὲ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: legō de touto hoti hekastos hymōn legei Egō men eimi Paulou Egō de Apollō Egō de Kēpha Egō de Christou
verses.literal: What I mean is this Individuals among you are saying I follow Paul I follow Apollos I follow Cephas or I follow Christ

verses.original: Μεμέρισται ὁ Χριστός μὴ Παῦλος ἐσταυρώθη ὑπὲρ ὑμῶν ἢ εἰς τὸ ὄνομα Παύλου ἐβαπτίσθητε
verses.transliteration: Memeristai ho Christos mē Paulos estaurōthē hyper hymōn ē eis to onoma Paulou ebaptisthēte
verses.literal: Is Christ divided Was Paul crucified for you Were you baptized into the name of Paul

verses.original: εὐχαριστῶ τῷ θεῷ ὅτι οὐδένα ὑμῶν ἐβάπτισα εἰ μὴ Κρίσπον καὶ Γάϊον
verses.transliteration: eucharistō tō theō hoti oudena hymōn ebaptisa ei mē Krispon kai Gaion
verses.literal: I thank God that I did not baptize any . . . of you except . . . Crispus and Gaius

verses.original: ἵνα μή τις εἴπῃ ὅτι εἰς τὸ ἐμὸν ὄνομα ἐβαπτίσθητε
verses.transliteration: hina mē tis eipē hoti eis to emon onoma ebaptisthēte
verses.literal: so no one can say that you were baptized into my name

verses.original: ἐβάπτισα δὲ καὶ τὸν Στεφανᾶ οἶκον λοιπὸν οὐκ οἶδα εἴ τινα ἄλλον ἐβάπτισα
verses.transliteration: ebaptisa de kai ton Stephana oikon loipon ouk oida ei tina allon ebaptisa
verses.literal: Yes I also baptized the household of Stephanas beyond that I do not remember if I baptized anyone else

verses.original: οὐ γὰρ ἀπέστειλέν με Χριστὸς βαπτίζειν ἀλλὰ εὐαγγελίζεσθαι οὐκ ἐν σοφίᾳ λόγου ἵνα μὴ κενωθῇ ὁ σταυρὸς τοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ou gar apesteilen me Christos baptizein alla euangelizesthai ouk en sophia logou hina mē kenōthē ho stauros tou Christou
verses.literal: For Christ did not send me to baptize but to preach the gospel not with words of wisdom lest . . . the cross of Christ be emptied of its power

verses.original: Ὁ λόγος γὰρ ὁ τοῦ σταυροῦ τοῖς μὲν ἀπολλυμένοις μωρία ἐστίν τοῖς δὲ σῳζομένοις ἡμῖν δύναμις Θεοῦ ἐστιν
verses.transliteration: Ho logos gar ho tou staurou tois men apollymenois mōria estin tois de sōzomenois hēmin dynamis Theou estin
verses.literal: For the message of the cross is foolishness to those who are perishing but to us who are being saved it is the power of God

verses.original: γέγραπται γάρ Ἀπολῶ τὴν σοφίαν τῶν σοφῶν καὶ τὴν σύνεσιν τῶν συνετῶν ἀθετήσω
verses.transliteration: gegraptai gar Apolō tēn sophian tōn sophōn kai tēn synesin tōn synetōn athetēsō
verses.literal: For it is written I will destroy the wisdom of the wise the intelligence of the intelligent I will frustrate

verses.original: Ποῦ σοφός ποῦ γραμματεύς ποῦ συζητητὴς τοῦ αἰῶνος τούτου οὐχὶ ἐμώρανεν ὁ Θεὸς τὴν σοφίαν τοῦ κόσμου
verses.transliteration: Pou sophos pou grammateus pou syzētētēs tou aiōnos toutou ouchi emōranen ho Theos tēn sophian tou kosmou
verses.literal: Where is the wise man Where is the scribe Where is the philosopher of this age Has not God made foolish the wisdom of the world

verses.original: ἐπειδὴ γὰρ ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ τοῦ Θεοῦ οὐκ ἔγνω ὁ κόσμος διὰ τῆς σοφίας τὸν Θεόν εὐδόκησεν ὁ Θεὸς διὰ τῆς μωρίας τοῦ κηρύγματος σῶσαι τοὺς πιστεύοντας
verses.transliteration: epeidē gar en tē sophia tou Theou ouk egnō ho kosmos dia tēs sophias ton Theon eudokēsen ho Theos dia tēs mōrias tou kērygmatos sōsai tous pisteuontas
verses.literal: For since in the wisdom of God the world through its wisdom did not know Him God was pleased through the foolishness of what was preached to save those who believe

verses.original: Ἐπειδὴ καὶ Ἰουδαῖοι σημεῖα αἰτοῦσιν καὶ Ἕλληνες σοφίαν ζητοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: Epeidē kai Ioudaioi sēmeia aitousin kai Hellēnes sophian zētousin
verses.literal: Jews demand signs and Greeks search for wisdom

verses.original: ἡμεῖς δὲ κηρύσσομεν Χριστὸν ἐσταυρωμένον Ἰουδαίοις μὲν σκάνδαλον ἔθνεσιν δὲ μωρίαν
verses.transliteration: hēmeis de kēryssomen Christon estaurōmenon Ioudaiois men skandalon ethnesin de mōrian
verses.literal: but we preach Christ crucified a stumbling block to Jews and foolishness to Gentiles

verses.original: αὐτοῖς δὲ τοῖς κλητοῖς Ἰουδαίοις τε καὶ Ἕλλησιν Χριστὸν Θεοῦ δύναμιν καὶ Θεοῦ σοφίαν
verses.transliteration: autois de tois klētois Ioudaiois te kai Hellēsin Christon Theou dynamin kai Theou sophian
verses.literal: but to those who are called both Jews and Greeks Christ the power of God and the wisdom of God

verses.original: Ὅτι τὸ μωρὸν τοῦ Θεοῦ σοφώτερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων ἐστίν καὶ τὸ ἀσθενὲς τοῦ Θεοῦ ἰσχυρότερον τῶν ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: Hoti to mōron tou Theou sophōteron tōn anthrōpōn estin kai to asthenes tou Theou ischyroteron tōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: For the foolishness of God is wiser than man’s wisdom and the weakness of God is stronger than man’s strength

verses.original: Βλέπετε γὰρ τὴν κλῆσιν ὑμῶν ἀδελφοί ὅτι οὐ πολλοὶ σοφοὶ κατὰ σάρκα οὐ πολλοὶ δυνατοί οὐ πολλοὶ εὐγενεῖς
verses.transliteration: Blepete gar tēn klēsin hymōn adelphoi hoti ou polloi sophoi kata sarka ou polloi dynatoi ou polloi eugeneis
verses.literal: Brothers consider the time of your calling Not many of you were wise by human standards . . . not many were powerful not many were of noble birth

verses.original: ἀλλὰ τὰ μωρὰ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ Θεός ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τοὺς σοφούς καὶ τὰ ἀσθενῆ τοῦ κόσμου ἐξελέξατο ὁ Θεός ἵνα καταισχύνῃ τὰ ἰσχυρά
verses.transliteration: alla ta mōra tou kosmou exelexato ho Theos hina kataischynē tous sophous kai ta asthenē tou kosmou exelexato ho Theos hina kataischynē ta ischyra
verses.literal: But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong

verses.original: καὶ τὰ ἀγενῆ τοῦ κόσμου καὶ τὰ ἐξουθενημένα ἐξελέξατο ὁ Θεός καὶ τὰ μὴ ὄντα ἵνα τὰ ὄντα καταργήσῃ
verses.transliteration: kai ta agenē tou kosmou kai ta exouthenēmena exelexato ho Theos kai ta mē onta hina ta onta katargēsē
verses.literal: He chose the lowly and despised things of the world and the things that are not to nullify the things that are

verses.original: ὅπως μὴ καυχήσηται πᾶσα σὰρξ ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: hopōs mē kauchēsētai pasa sarx enōpion tou Theou
verses.literal: so that no one may boast in His presence . . . . . .

verses.original: Ἐξ αὐτοῦ δὲ ὑμεῖς ἐστε ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὃς ἐγενήθη σοφία ἡμῖν ἀπὸ Θεοῦ δικαιοσύνη τε καὶ ἁγιασμὸς καὶ ἀπολύτρωσις
verses.transliteration: Ex autou de hymeis este en Christō Iēsou hos egenēthē sophia hēmin apo Theou dikaiosynē te kai hagiasmos kai apolytrōsis
verses.literal: It is because of Him that you are in Christ Jesus who has become for us wisdom from God our righteousness holiness and redemption

verses.original: ἵνα καθὼς γέγραπται Ὁ καυχώμενος ἐν Κυρίῳ καυχάσθω
verses.transliteration: hina kathōs gegraptai Ho kauchōmenos en Kyriō kauchasthō
verses.literal: Therefore as it is written Let him who boasts boast in the Lord
